item.title: Embarking On The OSCP
item.description: Hi, David here. It’s been too long! At the start of February, I officially started full time as a Penetration Tester. The job is great, and I’m enjoying it… but I’m not fully IMMERSED yet. Why is that? Well, I’ve been continuing with AI Security projects on the side. I think AI Security is very important, and there’s definitely room to make a lot of money. BUT, I want to focus back on becoming an Offensive Security expert.
